[[File:Gorad chathead.png|left]]
'''Gorad''' is an [[ogre]] who lives on an island north of [[Feldip Hills]]. To access the island the player must enter the hole south-west of [[Gu'Tanoth]]. He is killed during the [[Watchtower quest]]. He always drops [[big bones]] and the [[ogre tooth]] required to get the second part of the [[ogre relic]]. The ogre tooth appears in your inventory and not on the ground so you must have an empty inventory space to receive it. After the quest he may still be found on the island and killed as a regular ogre.
